entities.summary: Cesare Magati or Caesar Magatus was an Italian physician and professor of medicine. He is known chiefly from his book De rara medicatione Vulnerum (1616) where he promoted the idea of natural processes in wound healing. In 1618 he joined the Capuchin Order and the next year he took on the name of Padre Liberato da Scandiano.
